reasoning_content: The .NET SDK was installed successfully, but it requires libicu (the app uses the `de-DE` culture for FluentValidation, so invariant mode won't work). Let's install libicu via apt.

action.command: apt-get install -y libicu74 >>/tmp/icu.log 2>&1 || apt-get install -y libicu-dev >>/tmp/icu.log 2>&1; dotnet --version
